reuse.why: Every step goes through the existing linkBankSyncAccount helper (duplicate-link, closed-account and takeover rules, and the Fintegra link), reuses the unlink field set from unlinkAccount, and generalises the Akahu downloader instead of copying it.

duplication.why: Rules are written once in the shared link helper and the unlinked-fields object is shared with unlinkAccount; the new fintegraAccounts listing is a verbatim copy of akahuAccounts with a different URL.

placement.why: Link rules sit in the shared link routine before any side effect, download logic in sync.ts, server paths in server-config.ts and the provider id in SYNC_PROVIDERS.

scope.why: Adds an unrequested fintegra-accounts listing handler and desktop-client provider entries although the request says the client side is handled separately.

maintainability.why: Centralised and readable; the replaceExistingLink flag has to be hand-threaded through each provider wrapper, and the extra listing copy adds another per-provider function to maintain.

disguised_duplication.where: fintegraAccounts copies akahuAccounts verbatim apart from the server URL, not disguised.

abstraction_drift.where: linkBankSyncAccount in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts gains replaceExistingLink; the closed-account and already-linked checks apply to every provider with no provider-specific branches, and linkFintegraAccount calls the helper like the other providers. downloadAkahuTransactions becomes downloadServerTransactions(serverUrl, providerName, ...) used by Akahu and Fintegra.
